summary: The pixel-art style aesthetic is consistently maintained with cute character designs and themed hero objects like the moldy gourd. However, the visual narrative becomes very repetitive in the second half, and key visual actions like scraping with a spoon are completely unrepresented.

clean: Shot 0 displays the hanging calabash gourd growing on a vine clearly.
Shot 10 creates a fun visual representation of mold forming inside the gourd as a hero character.
unclean: Shot 13: Spoken text mentions scraping the interior with a spoon ('raspás con una cuchara'), but the character is just holding the mate normally without any spoon or action.
Shot 14-15: Continues to lack any spoon or scraping animation while repeating the same standard holding pose.

clean: Consistent 8-bit palette and clean pixel line work across characters and backgrounds.
Well-integrated pixelify text captions and end-screen poll UI.
unclean: Shots 11 through 15 reuse virtually identical character framing and static poses, creating visual monotony.

issues.problem: The text describes scraping with a spoon, but no spoon is visible in the frame.
issues.fix: Add a pixel spoon object in the figure's hand reaching inside the gourd.

issues.problem: Scraping motion described in audio is absent; figure remains static.
issues.fix: Animate the hand/spoon moving back and forth inside the top opening of the gourd.

issues.problem: Shot 12 repeats the exact standing pose and room angle as Shot 11.
issues.fix: Vary camera framing or show a close-up of adding warm water/used yerba.

learnings.rule: When a specific tool or action (like a spoon or scraping motion) is named in the narration, ensure that specific hero object is drawn in the hand and animated.
